data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'sh-q-q', meaning 'to love'. In Islamic spirituality, Asheeqa refers to a devoted lover of Allah. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
